text:
anya: Quick sync — did an int4 + fp8 sweep on mix-13B this morning. Observed ~6% perf regression on MATH subset and p95 latency up ~8% vs int8 on a100. Can someone run a focused profile and a small canary?
cheng: Can you paste the exact bench command, which weights/commit, and whether kv-cache was enabled?
anya: Sure — running on commit 8f4b2c9, weights tagged mix-13b-v2. Command I used:
```bash
./bench.sh --model mix-13B --quant int4 --kernels auto --seq 1024 --batch 1 --iters 500 --kv-cache on --profile minimal > /tmp/mix13b-int4.log
```
mike: quick note — earlier runs showed a spike in memcpy time when kernels switched to int4 path. Might be extra packing/unpacking. Could you run with --kv-cache off as well to compare?
anya: Will do both. Filing here so results are discoverable.
sarah: For quality: please run the eval suite with math and reasoning sets (GSM8K, MATH, DROP). Use the same seeds across quant modes. Example: 
```bash
eval_suite --models mix-13B --benchsets gsm8k,math,lambada --quant int8,int4,fp8 --seed 42 --out results.json
```
We need perplexity + exact-match where applicable. If quality drop >5% on MATH, we should auto-fallback to int8 for that route.
cheng: I'll take the GPU profiling. Running nsys/nsight next. Use: 
```bash
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx --output nsys_mix13b_int4 ./bench.sh --model mix-13B --quant int4 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --iters 200 --kv-cache on
# then extract kernels: nsys stats nsys_mix13b_int4.qdrep | grep -E "Kernel|Memcpy"
```
mike: Pasted excerpt from a previous int4 run (trimmed):
```
Kernel Time (ms): attention_kernel_v2  42.1
Kernel Time (ms): matmul_qk_int4       18.7
Memcpy HtoD (ms):  6.2
Memcpy DtoH (ms):  5.8
Packing time (ms): 3.4
Total p95 (our meter): 310ms (seq1024, batch1)
```
anya: Thanks — looks like packing + memcpy is non-trivial. I'll open a quick PR to add an opt-in per-model fallback policy (int4 -> int8) when quality_loss_pct > 5 or p95 > SLO. PR will include telemetry hooks. Pinged @cheng for review.
deploy-bot: Canary pool 'dedicated-gpu-a100' allocated for mix-13B-int4-canary (5 replicas) — start time 2028-11-04T09:22:30Z
infra-bot: Reminder: when you run profiling, please add --nvtx markers around token-generation loop so traces map to user ops. Example: 
```python
with nvtx.RangePush('generate_tokens'):
    model.generate(...)
```
sarah: Also add a telemetry metric `quant.quality_drop` with fields: model, quant_mode, benchset, pct_drop, baseline_commit. We need that in console to trigger alerting.
cheng: Starting microbench compare a10 vs a100 later today — hypothesis: different memory bandwidth/TCM behavior could change int4 packing overhead. If anyone has perf scripts that isolate packing, share them.
mike: I have a small repro that toggles per-channel vs per-tensor quantization. I'll drop the script in the bench repo under experiments/quant-pack.
anya: Timeline: I'll run evals (int8,int4,fp8) + kv-cache on/off tonight and post results. @cheng will upload nsys traces. If we see >5% quality hit on math, we'll enable auto-fallback and schedule a canary rollback test.
sarah: SLO reminder — product wants p95 < 350ms for seq512, and quality regression tolerated <=3% on reasoning tasks. If either violated, flag for mitigation.
anya: Got it. Will report back with results + links to logs. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
